audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[3].side and [5].side read Skill and phases[6].side read Vladimir, while content win[3], win[5] and win[6] all read Zed and the packet levelChart is Zed on all seven rows.
audit.why: Every why on those rows already argues Zed: 4-5 he dictates trades around the pool, first item he dives, 2+ items he picks. Vladimir's scaling is real but the content layer and the packet both call the rows for Zed, and phases[6].why describes Zed picking.
audit.corrected: phases[3], [5] and [6] side set to Zed with ratings aligned; win[N] untouched because it is already Zed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early paragraph said "his Transfusion costs health". It does not — Transfusion has no cost; Tides of Blood is the ability Vladimir pays his own health for.
audit.why: Riot kit: Q Transfusion cost 0, 9/7.9/6.8/5.7/4.6, 600 range, heals him and is empowered at full resource. E Tides of Blood "pays his own health to charge up a reservoir", 13/11/9/7/5. W Sanguine Pool 28/25/22/19/16, 2 seconds untargetable. R Hemoplague 120s flat, amplifies damage taken and heals him per champion hit.
audit.corrected: Health cost moved onto Tides of Blood everywhere; the 28s pool named as his real spike gate and the 9s Transfusion as the sustain clock.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions never reached the page: Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units, so standing behind the wave eats far less of it; and Vladimir sustains through chip, so Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.why: Riot text on E: "deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units". Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him (kit heal flags), and the missing-interactions file flags needs-antiheal for this pairing.
audit.corrected: Minion-block written into breakdown.cooldowns and phases[2].why; anti-heal timing written into spikes[2].text alongside the existing Itemization note.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint), and dosFull[2].d claimed a guarantee with no number.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in his kit and the only window that matters.
audit.corrected: 28s pool, 9s Transfusion and 20s Living Shadow written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string and dontsFull[2].d the tradeBad string, both pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles.
